# Weekly review

Read `.github/routine-guidance.md` and follow it. Review the preceding seven days unless the user specifies another period. Summarize evidenced progress, unresolved commitments, and time-sensitive upcoming events; do not infer completions or treat missing entries as failures. Offer one manageable primary next action and allow the review to be skipped or deferred. Do not change task statuses during the review.
